title.value: Test a browser agent on business tasks

introduction.value: A team tried Claude's browser agent on business scenarios; content creation finished in under 3 minutes, while spreadsheet structuring failed and cross-app work was mixed.

method.value: The team ran three business scenarios through Claude's Chrome extension on a paid Claude Pro plan, repeating each with varied instructions. The scenarios were writing an SEO blog post in Google Docs, pulling community posts into a Google Sheets tracker, and coordinating between ChatGPT and business apps. The agent worked from plain-language prompts.

outcome.value: The blog post was done in under 3 minutes and a follow-up rewrite with CTAs worked. The spreadsheet step put everything into single cells, even after correction. Moving information from ChatGPT into business apps failed.

notes.value: The extension needs broad browser permissions, and the authors suggest trying it on a separate machine first. It only worked in Chrome via the Claude web interface, not Claude Code or Desktop.

source_text.body:
Test a browser agent on business tasks
A team tried Claude's browser agent on business scenarios; content creation finished in under 3 minutes, while spreadsheet structuring failed and cross-app work was mixed.
Done with
CH
Claude in Chrome
CL
Claude
What they did
The team ran three business scenarios through Claude's Chrome extension on a paid Claude Pro plan, repeating each with varied instructions. The scenarios were writing an SEO blog post in Google Docs, pulling community posts into a Google Sheets tracker, and coordinating between ChatGPT and business apps. The agent worked from plain-language prompts.
How it went
The blog post was done in under 3 minutes and a follow-up rewrite with CTAs worked. The spreadsheet step put everything into single cells, even after correction. Moving information from ChatGPT into business apps failed.
Worth knowing
The extension needs broad browser permissions, and the authors suggest trying it on a separate machine first. It only worked in Chrome via the Claude web interface, not Claude Code or Desktop.
Try it yourself
with
Claude in Chrome
Copy prompt
I want to test how well you handle a real business task in my browser. The task: [describe a business task, e.g. draft a product announcement in Google Docs, or restructure the data in a spreadsheet at URL]. Work through it step by step, tell me when something doesn't work instead of guessing, and finish by summarizing what you completed, what failed, and how long it took. Pause and show me before sending, submitting, or deleting anything.
Original source: https://growwstacks.com/blog/claude-ai-browser-agent-automation-test
